deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.22-lite v3.4.0 -> eu-west-1 completed. Starting postdeploy slimcheck (10 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/1763781234 :rocket:
alex: slimcheck shows 2/10 failing: kv-prefill 503s, and embed p95 spike ~1.2s
hema: change window until 23:00 UTC. prefer mitigation over rollback if this is warmup-related
sre-olivia: checking eu-west-1a nodes, host-4 has kube restarts and prefill-worker OOMKilled entries. grabbing logs now
sre-olivia: logs snippet:
```bash
# kubectl -n inference logs deploy/kv-prefill -l host=eu-w-1a --tail=200
ERROR upstream 503 slow response
ContainerKilled: OOMKilled prefill-worker
```
ryan: v3.4.0 added a new quant allocator path, could increase prefill working set. Suggest variant-level soft-fallback: route 10% /embed -> stable-3.3 in eu-west-1, keep text-gen on v3.4
alex: agree, soft-fallback avoids full rollback and minimizes blast radius
maria: applying variant route change: embed 10% -> stable-3.3 (eu-west-1). monitoring slimcheck for 10m
release-coordinator: created RN-5342: "postdeploy investigation: prefill OOMs in eu-west-1a (v3.4.0)". PM assigned, triage ETA EOD tomorrow
sre-olivia: re-running slimcheck after fallback, now 9/10 pass. kv-prefill 503s gone, embed p95 back to ~350ms :white_check_mark:
hema: keep watch for 30m. If regressions return, escalate rollback. add runbook note to tune prefill-worker memory for quant allocator
ryan: opened OPS-1287 to collect allocator mem samples and heap profiles during warmup
alex: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/deploy-watch?orgId=1 monitoring p95, heap, OOMs. Staying on call 20m
release-coordinator: marking change window soft-hold until 23:00 UTC. release notes updated: "v3.4.0: lite rollout; temporary /embed fallback applied in eu-west-1 due to prefill instability; investigation ongoing."
maria: plan: if stable for 30m remove fallback and ramp to 100% across regions. if OOMs recur, rollback to 3.3 across affected routes will be considered
deploy-bot: slimcheck final: 9/10 pass. actions: applied 10% embed fallback -> stable-3.3; RN-5342 created; watch until 23:00 UTC :thumbsup:
hema: thanks all. ping this thread for immediate rollback decision if anything degrades.
